annotations.title: Media Upload, Auto-Fit Video & Clip Pipeline

description: Execute media ingestion, zero-egress storage uploads, automatic multi-aspect-ratio video reframing (`9:16`, `16:9`, `1:1`, `4:5`), viral short clip extraction with burned-in captions, and AI visual asset generation (`media_generate`). For files around 100 MB or larger (including a 579048031-byte original MP4), use `multipart_create` → PUT each part to the returned URLs (direct to R2) → `multipart_complete`. Do not send the whole file through `presign_upload` PUT or Cloudflare returns HTTP 413. `check_status` is ready only when the object bytes exist in storage. Use this tool before `posts_publish` whenever a campaign requires uploading video/image files or converting a single landscape video into vertical Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts.

action.description: Media pipeline operation: 'presign_upload' creates a signed Worker PUT URL (files ≲90 MB; larger hit Cloudflare 413), 'upload_base64' uploads inline (max 20 MB), 'multipart_create' starts R2 multipart for large originals (e.g. 579048031 bytes → 64 MiB × 9 parts), 'multipart_sign_part' returns per-part PUT URLs (direct to R2 when S3 tokens are set), 'multipart_complete' verifies size/checksum and marks ready only when the object exists, 'multipart_abort' cancels, 'auto_fit_video' reframes, 'extract_clips' cuts highlights, 'media_generate' renders from a prompt, 'check_status' reports ready only when stored bytes exist.

checksum.description: Optional SHA-256 hex of the original file. Verified on complete when R2 exposes a checksum.

clipCount.description: Number of short highlight clips (1 to 10) to extract from a long-form source video when `action` is 'extract_clips'.

contentType.description: MIME type for 'upload_base64' (alias of mimeType), e.g. 'image/jpeg'.

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes for 'upload_base64' (max 20 MB decoded).

fileName.description: Original file name with extension (e.g. 'keynote-demo.mp4' or 'launch-carousel.png') when requesting a presigned upload URL.

mediaAssetId.description: Existing media asset identifier (`med_...`) to reframe, extract clips from, or inspect status.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the media asset being uploaded or generated (e.g. 'video/mp4', 'image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/svg+xml').

partNumber.description: Single part number alternative to partNumbers.

partNumbers.description: Part numbers to sign (1-based). For a 579048031-byte file at 64 MiB parts use [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9]. Omit to sign every planned part.

partSizeBytes.description: Optional part size in bytes (default 67108864 / 64 MiB). Must be ≥ 5242880 for multi-part objects.

parts.description: Uploaded parts with ETags from each part PUT, required for 'multipart_complete'.

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) that owns the media asset.

prompt.description: Creative prompt or visual template instructions when running `action: 'media_generate'` (e.g. 'Minimalist B2B architecture diagram for MCP server launch').

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes used to validate upload quotas and allocate storage buffers.

targetAspectRatios.description: Target aspect ratios for automatic video/image reframing: '9:16' (Reels/TikTok/Shorts), '16:9' (X/LinkedIn/YouTube), '1:1' (Square), '4:5' (Portrait Feed).

uploadId.description: R2 multipart upload id returned by 'multipart_create'.
